description: As a Program Coordinator, I need vendor access requests to route for approval so that external participation only proceeds when required details are complete.

acceptanceRequirements.given: a vendor access request has approval and capacity details
acceptanceRequirements.when: the Program Coordinator submits the request for approval
acceptanceRequirements.then: the approver can approve or reject the request with a recorded decision

acceptanceRequirements.given: a vendor access request is missing required details
acceptanceRequirements.when: the Program Coordinator attempts to submit it for activation
acceptanceRequirements.then: the workflow pauses and prompts the coordinator to provide the missing information

description: As a Finance Analyst, I need approved launch plan items to prepare purchase order handoffs so that downstream purchasing reflects the planned materials and effort estimates.

acceptanceRequirements.given: a launch plan item has approved material and effort details
acceptanceRequirements.then: the handoff reflects the planned item and the approval packet that authorized it

acceptanceRequirements.given: a launch plan item has unresolved budget or material details
acceptanceRequirements.then: the unresolved item is excluded until the missing details are completed
